correctness.rationale: Direct run-count proof: N/4 runs per symbol and N/8 singleton runs per symbol follow from uniform length-2/3 de Bruijn factors; all mixed composition collisions correspond to one adjacent singleton-run slide, making a forest of exactly N/4 edges on (N/4)^2 run pairs; same-color outputs are C(N/4,2)+N/8. For n>=4, common untouched n-factor exists because 2^n-4n+2>0 and synchronizes cyclic output rotations; n=3 is exhausted. Full successor-table enumeration gives 2,16,2048 valid cycles at orders 3,4,5 and verifies every two-deletion output, plus 29 sampled order-six cycles.
